# Bury Digital

> A Melbourne automation studio building fixed-scope automation systems for Australian businesses. Lead intake, CRM & data operations, dashboards, and AI workflows — built into the client's own accounts, delivered in days for a fixed price, and handed over with full documentation and no lock-in.

Bury Digital is a solo studio run by Oscar Bury (Founder) in Melbourne, Victoria, serving businesses across Australia. Every engagement is a one-off, fixed-price build rather than a subscription or a retainer: the scope and price are agreed before any work starts, the system is built wherever possible on the client's own tools and credentials, and the client owns the result outright.

The work is connecting the tools a business already uses so that manual, repetitive jobs stop being done by hand — enquiries that go unanswered, data re-typed between an inbox, a spreadsheet and a CRM, numbers scattered across five tools with no single live view, and the same admin repeated every day.

Builds are typically implemented on n8n plus the client's existing systems. If a job can be automated with those tools, it is in scope even if it does not map neatly onto one of the four categories below.

## What Bury Digital builds

Four build categories. Each is priced in three tiers — Entry, Core, or Complex. All prices are in AUD and ex GST, and are indicative ranges; an exact fixed quote follows a call.

- [Lead generation & intake automation](https://bury-digital.com/#services): Capture every enquiry — from forms, inbox, phone or ads — qualify it, log it to the CRM, and route it to the right person the moment it lands. Entry $500–$900 (auto-acknowledgement plus a lead summary into the CRM or inbox); Core $1,200–$2,500 (full intake pipeline — qualification, CRM logging, routing); Complex $3,000–$5,000 (multi-channel, conversational qualification with escalation routing).
- [CRM & data operations](https://bury-digital.com/#services): Clean, dedupe, enrich, migrate, and sync data so every tool stays in step automatically. Entry $500–$900 (CRM cleanup and dedupe with a documented ruleset); Core $1,200–$2,500 (sync or migration between tools, plus an enrichment pipeline); Complex $3,000–$5,000 (full data-ops layer — scheduled syncs, validation, alerting).
- [Dashboards & reporting](https://bury-digital.com/#services): Pull numbers out of multiple tools into one live picture, fed straight from existing systems. Entry $500–$900 (automated weekly report by email or Slack); Core $1,200–$2,500 (live dashboard fed by automated pipelines); Complex $3,000–$4,500 (multi-source ops dashboard with alert thresholds).
- [AI content & ops workflows](https://bury-digital.com/#services): Put AI to work on real jobs — inbox triage, review responses, content repurposing, document generation, multi-step ops assistants. Entry $500–$900 (one targeted workflow); Core $1,200–$2,500 (content-repurposing pipeline or document-generation workflow); Complex $3,000–$5,000 (multi-step ops assistant across a full function).

Optional after go-live: ongoing monitoring and small tweaks from $200–$500/month, cancel anytime. This is optional and separate from the build price — there is no subscription to the software itself.

## Delivery model

- [Fixed price, fixed scope](https://bury-digital.com/#using): What gets built and what it costs are agreed before work starts. No hourly meter, no scope creep, no open-ended retainer.
- [Built in the client's own accounts](https://bury-digital.com/#using): Wherever possible everything runs on the client's own tools and credentials, not locked inside Bury Digital. The client owns it and can walk away with it at any time.
- [Full handover, no lock-in](https://bury-digital.com/#using): Every build ships with an export of the whole system, written documentation, and a walkthrough video, so the client — or anyone they hire later — can run and change it.
- Delivery times: Entry builds are usually 1–2 days, Core 3–6 days, Complex 1–3 weeks. A firm timeline comes with the fixed quote.
- Support: a 7-day defect-fix window after handover is included in every build. If something built doesn't work as agreed, it is fixed at no charge.
- Payment terms: Entry builds 100% upfront; Core 50% deposit and 50% on delivery; Complex staged by milestone.

## Example build (anonymised)

- [Lead intake for an Australian law firm](https://bury-digital.com/): A missed-call intake system. In week one it recovered **12 missed-call leads**, replied in **~3 seconds** on average, and achieved a **67% caller reply rate**. Real, anonymised figures from an Australian firm; the client is not named. These are leads captured and replies received — not won clients or revenue.
